name: Boughs in the Wind

angles.text: As fewer youths show an affinity for magic each passing year, participating in the crafting of a traditional spell focus helps preserve your people's ancestral culture in Zephras.
Crafting a spell focus from wind-infused boughs marks an early rite of passage for spellcasters learning to channel elemental resonance.

aliases: what is boughs in the wind
faq.answer: Boughs in the Wind is a rite of passage quest where an aspiring spellcaster gathers a wind-infused fallen branch to craft their own spell focus. It represents an ancient custom practiced to preserve the magical heritage of Zephras.
faq.q: What is the quest Boughs in the Wind?

faq.answer: Belann Windwood is a mentor located in Valanaar who guides young spellcasters through the traditional crafting of their spell focus. He observes with concern that fewer people display a gift for magic with each passing year.

The wind-infused boughs fall from the oldest trees located near the wind shrine, situated just south of Falaath Village. Belann points apprentices toward this shrine because its ancient wood retains trace elemental currents.
faq.q: Where do you find the Wind-Infused Bough?

faq.answer: In local tradition, apprentices craft their own spell focus once they demonstrate magical proficiency. The focus channels elemental energies, serving as both a working conduit for spellcasting and an initiation into cultural rites.
faq.q: Why do young spellcasters create a spell focus?

faq.answer: Belann Windwood notes that tradition holds the branch often chooses the spellcaster rather than the other way around. He remarks that a suitable bough may seem to sing to someone possessing the sensitivity to wield elemental winds.
faq.q: Why does Belann ask if the branch sang to you?

faq.answer: Zephras is the land where this tradition takes place. According to Belann Windwood, every passing year in Zephras sees fewer individuals born with a natural talent for magic, making the continuation of ancient rites vital.
faq.q: What is happening to magic in Zephras?

sections.body: In the lands of Zephras, young spellcasters who display nascent magical talent undergo a traditional rite of passage: fashioning their own spell focus. Mentors such as Belann Windwood in Valanaar guide apprentices through this ancient practice, tasking them with collecting a fallen branch from the region's eldest trees. These venerable boughs hold lingering elemental traces of the wind, making them ideal conduits for channeling spells.
sections.title: A Rite of Passage

sections.body: The most potent boughs are gathered near the wind shrine situated just south of Falaath Village, where elemental currents naturally gather. Tradition holds that the branch often chooses the spellcaster, sometimes said to quietly sing to those sensitive enough to harness its power. For elders like Belann, each student who completes the ritual represents a vital continuation of their culture, especially as fewer individuals in Zephras are born with a gift for magic with each passing year.
sections.title: Whispers at the Wind Shrine

summary: Boughs in the Wind is a traditional rite of passage where an apprentice gathers a wind-infused branch near Falaath Village to fashion a spell focus. Guided by Belann Windwood in Valanaar, the practice honors an ancient custom at a time when magical talent in Zephras is steadily dwindling.
